answer: Sybil resistance via fuzzy reputation commitments with layered staking. Each identity's reputation is a 'nebula' of fuzzy commitments that a farm cannot crisply distinguish, so buying many fakes blurs their identity. Weight is gated by a 'saffron' threshold: only identities past a hard earned-reputation floor earn full attestation power. A 'shale' of time-layered stakes means mass-spawned fakes unlock in separate future epochs, so a cluster can't mobilize its whole balance at once. Attacker cost: blurred identities plus staggered stake maturation.
